A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5

ledger.why: Content note: the owner's per-event content note (the coming per-event content-notes feature shows it; listed in the build report's content-note table), never part of a page

collection.description: A villager wonders whether distant communities welcome people with different appearances, abilities, beliefs, and ways of living.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A villager wonders whether distant communities welcome people with different appearances, abilities, beliefs, and ways of living.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children describe a town where everyone can participate in work and celebration.

text_only.reason: a celebration imagined or discussed (or a feeling of joy); no celebration happens in the game

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A disabled villager asks whether the imagined town has accessible paths and tools, not merely kind words.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A storyteller describes someone unfairly excluded and the community members who challenge it.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A listener recalls an injustice closer to home; the group considers its own responsibilities.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A villager says people should be allowed ordinary lives without constantly defending who they are.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Another notes that questions can be sincere or intrusive; the group practices asking respectfully.
